title: Each way in warns before its wave: a siren and lamps that show how big, 20 s ahead
rule: Where attackers come from several holes or tunnels, each hole has its own looping siren and three lamps beside it. Before a wave, the holes it will use sound their siren and light one, two or three lamps for a small, middling or big wave; the attackers come out about 20 s later (15 s for the last wave); the siren stops when the first one is out and the lamps go out when that hole's attackers are all dead. Players learn where to stand and how bad it will be from the world alone, with no text. Changing how our nest or any defence announces its waves: ask the owner first.

title: A wave fight grows by how many ways in are open, rests 6 s between waves, and stops itself if the room is overrun
rule: A defence against waves of creatures runs from one counter and a case: wave 1 uses one way in, then two, three, three, four, four, then all at once for the last; a wave ends when every open way's attackers are dead (the counter's target set to how many ways are open). Between waves: a 6 s rest, a save point, the NPC defenders say a line for that wave and are healed to full. Two safety valves: if 8 attackers are inside the defended room at once, the wave is cut short (no more come); corpses are capped at 3. Late in the fight the defence is taken down on purpose (the two turrets run dry at 50 and 60 s of wave 6), so the last waves feel desperate, and help arrives for the last one. When it ends, stragglers are killed off out of sight and the music fades in 7 s. Changing how our waves run: ask the owner first.

title: When the fight is won, the attackers left over walk off to a far spot and vanish there, out of sight

rule: In a long fight against a gunship or helicopter, the places players hide in are taken away one at a time: every 20 s one shelter is picked at random and bombed, and it breaks apart in one go (its pieces freed, a burst, fire, a scorch mark), with a danger sound first so NPCs clear out. Hits on the aircraft bring a bigger bomb; at half health it makes a last effort. Players must keep moving instead of camping one spot. Combine air support in our fights: ask the owner first.
why: ep2_outland_08: timer_crate_activate (logic_timer refire 20) > case_destruction PickRandomShuffle; trigger_bomb_outside_shack (filtered, wait 1.5) > chopper DropBombAtTargetAlways target_bomb_11; relay_healthshack_1 (19 lines: physboxes EnableMotion, break_healthshack_1 Break @0.3, propane Break @0.2, explosions @0.1, a gib shooter, a decal, fire, brushes swapped, aisound_explosion_1 EmitAISound @0.3); relay_exploding_tower (30 lines), relay_exploding_shack (12). npc_helicopter chopper: OnDamaged > counter_megabomb (max 3) > relay_megabomb; OnHalfHealth > relay_megabomb (once); OnShotDown > crash alarm, cheers @1, save.
how: Gamemode (ask first): if a gunship ever joins a district fight, give it a list of the district's shelters and let it wreck one every 20 s, each shelter a swap set (valve-swap-broken).

extra.how: EP2's numbers: blows on a door at 0, 2, 4, 5, 5.5, 5.8, 6 and 6.1 s before it bursts (ep2_outland_06 lrelay_sound_banging_01); a breaching charge beeps every 2 s, every 0.2 s from 8 s and blows at 9 s, the door swapped for a broken one and the assault at 9.5 s (ep2_outland_07 relay_bustfrontdoor, timer_frontExitBomb).

EP2 besiegers shoot at window bullseyes in sets that change every 6 to 8 s (front 2, 4, 6 from 0 to 6 s, front 1, 2, 3 from 8 to 15 s, again at 17 s: ep2_outland_10 inn_front_windows_bullseyes_relay).

EP2 leans on it most: 161 ai_script_conditions in 18 maps (48 in ep2_outland_12), FOV 45 to 60 with a true cone, timeouts 3 to 16 s after which the moment happens anyway (01a ceiling spitter, 06a hunters).

EP2's zombie miners slump on work hints (hinttype 12, zombie_slump_a and _b, 21 in ep2_outland_03) held by ai_goal_actbusy with a search range of 64, each to his own spot; the wake relay deactivates the goals at 0, 1, 3, 5 and 7 s so they rise in turn.

EP2's whole buildings: ep2_outland_12 cabin_destroy_relay (25 lines: brushes, lods and props killed, breakables broken, physics props and boxes let go, a wire let go and caught at 2 s, sparks stopped at 20 and 30 s, smoke at 1 s, the ruin from templates).

EP2's launch (ep2_outland_12a relay_launch, 28 lines from one button): warning sounds at 0 and 20 s, a voice at 5, silo doors and dust at 3, birds fly off at 3, rumble dust at 10, 20, 25, a shake timer from 3 to 36 s, the rocket at 30; the count shows on four digit panels by animated texture frames (StartAnimSequence), 30 to 0.

EP2's monitor watcher (ep2_outland_11): a button steps a screen through five channels (math_counter 1 to 6 wrapping, logic_case); the rebel thanks you when it is back on his, reacts when you change it, and after four changes away says he is fed up (math_mon_hatelife max 4).

EP2's version with cables (ep2_outland_06a): physics plugs carried to sockets (trigger_multiple, physics flag 8, filtered by the plug's name) that snap them in; two right sockets per route (logic_branch_listener OnAllTrue) light a lamp on the socket, the tower's lamps, the radio and a hum; pulling a plug out (OnPhysGunPickup added at run time) turns it all off again.

EP2's White Forest gate (ep2_outland_10a): the lookout in the gate tower calls down to the man at the gate and the gate slides open on his line (base_gate_tower_citizen_lcs OnTrigger1 > base_gate_open_relay).

EP2's version (ep2_outland_06): Alyx's rifle is an npc_sniper (shootzombiesinchest 1) whose laser sweeps a target group chosen by the zone the player is in (SweepGroupRandomly, one trigger per zone), painting every 1 s (varied 0.75), every 0.25 s once she guides him; killed and respawned from a template as she moves on.

EP2's medic (ep2_outland_08): Alyx polls the player's health every 3 s (logic_playerproxy RequestPlayerHealth into logic_compare 75); below 75 she fetches a medkit and throws it when he looks at her (ai_script_conditions, FOV 55). In ep2_outland_02 each new wave sets the NPC defenders' health to 100.

EP2's White Forest (ep2_outland_11, 12a): a vortigaunt with a broom walks between four sweeping spots picked at random after each sweep (case_sweepSpots PickRandom on the scene's completion), a dust puff on while it sweeps; two welders (a spark and sound every 1.5 to 3 s; skip their light, no flickering); a gun class (a teacher with an AR2, three pupils with arms crossed); a consoling couple (ai_goal_actbusy); odd-job rebels from makers, each given one of two random jobs (ep2_outland_10a).

EP2's striderbuster school (ep2_outland_11b): the practice devices are duds (dud 1); the teacher's scene pauses at each step and resumes when it is done (Pause, then Resume from a trigger), a nag after 20 s of dawdling; a missed throw (OnShatter) gets one of three lines and a new device from the pad 1 s later.
